request.query: For arbitrary size function h the Finsupp sum over zero is zero, without h i 0 = 0.

items.name: Finsupp.sum_zero_index
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_8} {N : Type u_10} [inst : Zero M] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid N] {h : α → M → N},
  Finsupp.sum 0 h = 0

items.name: DFinsupp.sum_zero_index
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u} {γ : Type w} {β : ι → Type v} [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : (i : ι) → AddCommMonoid (β i)]
  [inst_2 : (i : ι) → (x : β i) → Decidable (x ≠ 0)] [inst_3 : AddCommMonoid γ] {h : (i : ι) → β i → γ},
  DFinsupp.sum 0 h = 0

items.name: Finsupp.sum_fun_zero
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_8} {N : Type u_10} [inst : Zero M] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid N] (f : α →₀ M),
  (f.sum fun x x_1 => 0) = 0

items.name: Finsupp.sum_single_index
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_8} {N : Type u_10} [inst : Zero M] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid N] {a : α} {b : M}
  {h : α → M → N}, h a 0 = 0 → (Finsupp.single a b).sum h = h a b
